Summary: The paper "DRAGIN: Dynamic Retrieval Augmented Generation based on the Real-time Information Needs of Large Language Models" proposes a novel dynamic RAG framework called DRAGIN that optimizes when and what to retrieve based on the real-time information needs of the LLM. The paper evaluates DRAGIN along with existing methods over four knowledge-intensive generation datasets using three different LLMs, showing that DRAGIN achieves state-of-the-art performance. The paper was presented at the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL) in August 2024 in Bangkok, Thailand.
